verdict.rationale: Yubico's FIDO2 docs state the key can enforce user verification via PIN entry in addition to touch. ykman manages PINs, and a community report confirms a FIDO2 PIN can be set, though keys ship without one and must be re-enrolled after setting it. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party FIDO2 PIN/UV documentation beyond the SSH guide, any evidence of a built-in biometric option, and evidence that UV can be forced at the key level rather than left optional and off by default.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the key supports on-device user verification — a FIDO2 PIN or built-in biometric — so a stolen key alone cannot authenticate

citations.quote: FIDO2 also requires user presence (a touch on your YubiKey) for cryptographic operations, and can optionally enforce user verification (PIN entry).
Full scriptable device management: enable applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info.
you need to unenroll everywhere, set a PIN, and enroll again.
